blocks.html:
Custom Vinyl Letterings: More Customers for No More Laundry

This is the process of how we helped No More Laundry, a Toronto-based laundry service, increase their brand visibility through custom vinyl lettering on their Nissan NV200.

No More Laundry was founded to provide a convenient and affordable laundry service for busy working professionals in Toronto. They provide washing, folding, and delivery services that make their clients’ lives easier. The company has grown quickly thanks to its dedicated team of employees and loyal customers, who love the convenience of getting their laundry done at home or work without having to leave their homes or offices.

To help boost its brand visibility even further, No More Laundry turned to Vinyl Wrap Toronto for help designing and installing custom vinyl letterings on its Nissan NV200 van. We installed the custom vinyl letterings so that they would be visible from all angles when driving around town—and even when parked! With these new custom vinyl letterings installed, No More Laundry can reach more potential customers than ever before!

If you would like to personalize your car, truck, boat, or other personal items – as long as it fits into our garage and has a smooth surface, we would love to wrap it! For your inspiration or your next partial wrap with Vinyl Wrap Toronto, do not forget to check out our Portfolio.

Get a Free Quote today by filling out the form and our team will get back to you as soon as possible. You can reach us at 416-746-1381 or email us at info@vinylwraptoronto.com. You can also visit us at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4.
